items.title: The effect of multimodal sensory therapy in consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (18 studies, 884 participants) found that multimodal sensory therapy significantly improved consciousness levels (SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92) and increased the odds of coma emergence (OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01) in adults with acquired brain injury-related disorders of consciousness.
items.curatedReason: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤（ABI）意识障碍患者确实有效。这项纳入 884 名患者的系统综述表明，MST 不仅显著改善意识水平，还将昏迷苏醒的可能性提高了近 10 倍。你可以更自信地将 MST 整合到你的康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤患者意识改善效果的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（18 项研究，884 名参与者）发现，多模式感觉疗法显著改善了获得性脑损伤伴意识障碍成年患者的意识水平（SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92），并增加了昏迷苏醒的可能性（OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal sensory therapy (MST) is effective for adults with acquired brain injury (ABI) and disorders of consciousness. This systematic review of 884 participants shows MST not only significantly improves consciousness levels but also increases the odds of coma emergence by nearly 10-fold. You can more confidently integrate MST into your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究存在方法学局限性和异质性，建议未来试验采用标准化方案和验证性评估。
items.limitationEn: Included studies had methodological limitations and heterogeneity, suggesting future trials should use standardized protocols and validated assessments.

items.title: REmotely monitored, Mobile health-supported Multidomain Rehabilitation with High Intensity Interval Training for COVID-19 (REMM-HIIT-CoV): Trial Design and Rationale.
items.summary: The REMM-HIIT-CoV trial is a multicenter, single-blinded RCT (N=140) evaluating a 12-week remotely delivered, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation program with high-intensity interval training for post-hospitalized COVID-19 survivors, primarily assessing 6-minute walk distance at 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项正在进行的 RCT 旨在验证远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复结合高强度间歇训练（HIIT）对新冠住院患者出院后功能锻炼能力的改善作用。其结果有望为严重呼吸道感染后居家远程康复提供循证指南和政策相关模型。
items.titleZh: REMM-HIIT-CoV：远程监测、移动健康支持结合高强度间歇训练治疗 COVID-19 的多领域康复试验设计与原理
items.summaryZh: REMM-HIIT-CoV 试验是一项多中心、单盲随机对照试验（N=140），旨在评估一项为期 12 周的远程交付、移动健康支持的多领域康复计划（包含高强度间歇训练）对新冠住院幸存者的效果，主要评估 3 个月时的 6 分钟步行距离。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of remotely delivered, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation combined with high-intensity interval training (HIIT) for post-hospitalized COVID-19 survivors is not yet established. This 140-person RCT, primarily assessing 6-minute walk distance at 3 months, is worth watching. If effective, it could provide crucial evidence for home-based remote rehabilitation.

items.title: Item-level analysis and network analysis of the functional independence measure cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study (N=974) analyzed FIM cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke, identifying item-level heterogeneity and two major conditional associations: comprehension-expression (r=0.71) and memory-problem solving (r=0.55).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提供了 FIM 认知子量表在卒中患者出院时的项目层面分析，揭示了理解-表达和记忆-问题解决的条件关联。这有助于你在出院计划时，更精细地解读 FIM 认知评分，识别患者的具体认知异质性。
items.titleZh: 急性卒中患者出院时功能独立性评定（FIM）认知项目的项目层面与网络分析
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究（N=974）分析了急性卒中患者出院时的 FIM 认知项目，发现项目层面存在异质性，并揭示了两个主要的条件关联：理解-表达（r=0.71）和记忆-问题解决（r=0.55）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study provides an item-level analysis of FIM cognitive subscale at discharge in stroke patients, revealing conditional associations between comprehension-expression and memory-problem solving. This helps you interpret FIM cognitive scores more precisely during discharge planning, identifying specific cognitive heterogeneity in patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察设计，且缺乏与外部结局的纵向验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective observational design and lacks longitudinal validation against external outcomes.

items.title: Age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as predictors of functional ability in people with spinal cord injury: a 6-month follow-up study.
items.summary: A 6-month follow-up study of 367 inpatients with traumatic SCI found that younger age (β = -0.02; p = 0.028), higher resilience (β = 0.22; p < 0.001), and higher health literacy (β = 0.32; p = 0.001) were independent predictors of greater functional ability, though overall improvement was modest (MBI 43.50 to 46.81).
items.curatedReason: 这项单中心随访研究提示，脊髓损伤患者出院后前 6 个月的功能恢复，除了年龄，还跟你的心理韧性、健康素养相关。临床上，在常规康复计划中整合心理支持和健康教育，可能为年轻患者带来额外助益。
items.titleZh: 年龄、心理韧性、社会支持和健康素养在脊髓损伤患者功能能力中的预测作用：一项 6 个月随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 367 名创伤性脊髓损伤住院患者的 6 个月随访研究发现，虽然总体功能改善幅度不大（MBI 从 43.50 升至 46.81），但更年轻的年龄（β = -0.02）、更高的心理韧性（β = 0.22）和更高的健康素养（β = 0.32）是功能能力更佳的独立预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center follow-up study suggests that functional recovery in the first 6 months post-discharge for SCI patients is associated with age, psychological resilience, and health literacy. Clinically, integrating psychological support and health education into routine rehabilitation plans may provide additional benefits for younger patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性研究，且功能改善的幅度非常有限，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center observational study, and the observed improvement in functional ability was modest, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Stroke survivors' experience using mechanically-assisted devices as a component of their upper limb motor rehabilitation program.
items.summary: A qualitative study interviewing 11 stroke survivors (mean age 63.2 years, less than 6 months post-stroke) identified five major themes regarding their experience with mechanically-assisted upper limb devices, emphasizing intrinsic motivation, goal-oriented feedback, and the crucial role of clinician involvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中患者使用机械辅助上肢康复设备的复杂体验。作为临床医师，你应在提供设备时注重激发患者内在动机，确保反馈目标导向，并积极参与设备的设置和调整，不能只把设备推给患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者将机械辅助设备作为上肢运动康复项目组成部分的体验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 11 名卒中幸存者（平均年龄 63.2 岁，卒中后不到 6 个月）的定性访谈研究揭示了他们使用机械辅助上肢设备的五大主题，强调了内在动机、目标导向反馈以及临床医师关键作用的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the complex experiences of stroke survivors using mechanically-assisted upper limb rehabilitation devices. As a clinician, you should focus on fostering intrinsic motivation and providing goal-oriented feedback when offering devices, and actively participate in device setup and adjustments, rather than merely assigning the device to the patient.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（11 人），结果的普遍性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (11 participants), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Exercise-only interventions and exercise-based multidomain lifestyle interventions to promote cognitive function in older adults without dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies found that exercise-only interventions significantly improved executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults without dementia compared to control. Exercise-plus interventions (exercise combined with other lifestyle factors) were significantly better than control for memory, and better than exercise-only for executive functions and processing speed, but not memory.
items.curatedReason: 运动仍是老年人维持认知功能的一线方案。这项纳入 227 项研究的系统综述证实，单纯运动能显著改善执行功能、记忆和处理速度；若想在执行功能和处理速度上更进一步，再结合其他干预，效果会优于单纯运动。
items.titleZh: 单纯运动干预及基于运动的多领域生活方式干预对无痴呆老年人认知功能的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 227 项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，与对照组相比，单纯运动干预能显著改善无痴呆老年人的执行功能、记忆力和处理速度。而运动加其他生活方式干预（Exercise-Plus）在记忆力方面优于对照组，且在执行功能和处理速度方面优于单纯运动干预，但在记忆力方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise remains the first-line strategy for maintaining cognitive function in older adults. This systematic review of 227 studies confirms that exercise alone significantly improves executive functions, memory, and processing speed. If you aim for greater gains in executive functions and processing speed, combining exercise with other interventions will be superior to exercise alone.
items.limitation: 多域干预的具体组成和剂量在不同研究中可能存在异质性，影响其普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The specific composition and dosage of multi-domain interventions may vary across studies, affecting their general applicability.

items.title: Perceptions and Experiences of Returning to Sport Following Myocardial Infarction: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored perceptions and experiences of returning to sport after a myocardial infarction, identifying themes like reconciling active identity with new reality, feeling vulnerable, needing strong support, and navigating their own path, highlighting significant psychosocial challenges alongside high motivation.
items.curatedReason: 心脏病发作后的运动重返不只是体能问题，心理因素同样关键。本研究提醒你除了运动处方，还要关注患者的身份认同、恐惧以及提供个体化的支持，别只盯着生理指标。
items.titleZh: 心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与经验，揭示了将运动身份与新现实调和、脆弱感、需要强力支持和自我探索路径等主题，强调了心理社会挑战与高动机并存。
items.curatedReasonEn: Returning to sport after a myocardial infarction isn't just about physical readiness; psychosocial factors are equally crucial. This study reminds you to address patients' identity, fears, and provide individualized support beyond just exercise prescriptions, rather than solely focusing on physiological metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，仅限于理解个体感知和经验，不提供干预的疗效证据。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study is limited to understanding individual perceptions and experiences and does not provide evidence on intervention efficacy.

items.title: The Effects of Exergames on Fundamental Movement Skills in Childhood: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (17 comparisons) concluded that low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activities for fundamental movement skill adaptation in children. The variability in effects was explained by coaching and activity structure, rather than exergame status itself.
items.curatedReason: 儿童基本运动技能适应，低门槛体感游戏和传统活动一样有效，重点在教练和活动结构。放心地把体感游戏纳入儿科康复方案吧，它们的效果不逊于传统方法，关键在于如何设计和指导。
items.titleZh: 体感游戏对儿童基本运动技能的影响：系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项研究（17 项比较）的系统综述和 Meta 分析得出结论，低门槛体感游戏在儿童基本运动技能适应方面与传统活动同样有效。效果差异主要由教练和活动结构解释，而非体感游戏本身。
items.curatedReasonEn: Low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activities for fundamental movement skill adaptation in children; the key lies in coaching and activity structure. Feel confident integrating exergames into pediatric rehab plans, as their efficacy is comparable to traditional methods, provided they are well-designed and guided.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是实验条件下的技能适应，尚需更多研究来评估体感游戏在真实社区环境和长期生活方式干预中的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on skill adaptation under experimental conditions; more research is needed to evaluate the effects of exergames in real-world community settings and as long-term lifestyle interventions.

items.title: Real-time continuous assessment of fatigue from surface electromyography with deep learning for training load regulation in elite cyclists
items.summary: A deep learning model combining CNN, Bi-LSTM, and channel attention mechanisms was developed to continuously estimate fatigue from raw sEMG signals during high-intensity cycling in 14 elite cyclists. The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.048 ± 0.019 and a Pearson correlation of 0.822 ± 0.123, showing superior accuracy over baseline models.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究展示的深度学习模型能从 sEMG 信号实时评估运动员疲劳，精度可观。对于运动康复医师来说，这预示着未来在训练负荷管理和伤病预防方面，能有更客观、精细的工具。
items.titleZh: 利用深度学习从表面肌电信号实时连续评估疲劳，用于精英自行车运动员训练负荷调节
items.summaryZh: 一项深度学习模型，结合了 CNN、Bi-LSTM 和通道注意力机制，用于在 14 名精英自行车运动员高强度骑行中，从原始表面肌电信号连续估计疲劳。该模型实现了 0.048 ± 0.019 的平均绝对误差和 0.822 ± 0.123 的皮尔逊相关系数，显示出优于基线模型的准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The deep learning model presented in this study demonstrates impressive accuracy in real-time fatigue assessment from sEMG signals in athletes. For sports rehabilitation clinicians, this heralds more objective and precise tools for training load management and injury prevention in the future.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（14 名精英自行车运动员），且是单项冲刺运动，模型的外推性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (14 elite cyclists) and focused on a single sprint exercise, so the generalizability of the model is not yet clear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Neurophysiological and neuromuscular responses associated with the repeated bout effect following eccentric exercise in healthy adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies found that peripheral contractile outcomes showed the most consistent recovery-compatible pattern after repeated eccentric exercise bouts. Evidence concerning central activation and motor-unit behavior was limited or inconsistent, leaving the contribution of neural changes to the repeated bout effect unresolved.
items.curatedReason: 重复离心运动效应（RBE）背后的神经生理学机制，目前看来外周收缩功能改变的证据最强。中枢激活和运动单位行为的作用证据有限且不一致，别急着把RBE归因于神经募集的改变。
items.titleZh: 健康成人离心运动后重复训练效应相关的神经生理与神经肌肉反应：系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 12 项研究的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，在重复离心运动后，外周收缩结果表现出最一致的恢复相容模式。关于中枢激活和运动单位行为的证据有限或不一致，重复训练效应中神经变化的具体贡献仍未解决。
items.curatedReasonEn: For the neurophysiological mechanisms behind the repeated bout effect (RBE), peripheral contractile changes show the most consistent evidence. Evidence for central activation and motor-unit behavior is limited and inconsistent; don't hastily attribute RBE to changes in neural recruitment.
items.limitation: 由于纳入研究数量较少，所有汇总分析都被视为探索性的，且研究间异质性可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: Due to the small number of included studies, all pooled analyses were considered exploratory, and inter-study heterogeneity might affect result stability.

items.title: Lumbar disc herniation with giant extruded or sequestered morphology: feasibility of a conservative-first strategy and the stratification value of contrast-enhanced MRI
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort of 60 patients with giant extruded or sequestered lumbar disc herniation showed an 11.7% surgery conversion rate within 24 months, with 88.3% achieving nonoperative success. Rim enhancement on MRI was associated with greater 6-month volume reduction but its value for predicting surgery conversion was exploratory.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，即便巨大腰椎间盘突出（突出或游离），保守治疗的成功率也接近九成。这强化了当前指南，即这类患者并非必须立即手术。不过，MRI 强化特征的临床分层价值仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: 巨大突出或游离型腰椎间盘突出：保守治疗的可行性与增强 MRI 的分层价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察队列研究显示，60 例巨大突出或游离型腰椎间盘突出患者在 24 个月内手术转化率为 11.7%，88.3% 的患者保守治疗成功。MRI 边缘强化与 6 个月时椎间盘体积更大程度缩小相关，但其对手术转化的预测价值仍属探索性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that even with giant extruded or sequestered lumbar disc herniation, conservative treatment has a success rate of nearly 90%. This reinforces current guidelines that immediate surgery is not mandatory for these patients. However, the stratification value of MRI enhancement features still requires further validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性队列研究，且样本量较小（60 例），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center observational cohort study with a small sample size (60 patients), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Pelvic morphology decoupling from lumbar lordosis in chronic low back pain
items.summary: A cross-sectional study compared 72 healthy volunteers and 72 chronic low back pain (CLBP) patients, finding that in CLBP, lumbar lordosis was decoupled from pelvic morphology. The sacral base angle (SBA) exhibited an amplified relationship with lordosis in CLBP patients, suggesting a biomechanical pattern of pelvic retroversion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现慢性腰痛患者的腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间的耦合关系减弱，转而更依赖骶骨倾斜。这为制定个性化的矢状面康复方案提供了新的生物力学靶点。
items.titleZh: 慢性腰痛中骨盆形态与腰椎前凸的解耦
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究比较了 72 名健康志愿者和 72 名慢性腰痛患者，发现在慢性腰痛患者中，腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间存在解耦现象。骶骨底角（SBA）与腰椎前凸的关系在慢性腰痛患者中表现出三倍的放大效应，提示骨盆后倾的生物力学模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that the coupling between lumbar lordosis and pelvic morphology is weakened in chronic low back pain patients, becoming more dependent on sacral inclination. This provides a new biomechanical target for developing individualized sagittal rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，不能建立因果关系，且对照组与慢性腰痛组在年龄和性别构成上存在显著差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study that cannot establish causality, and there were significant differences in age and sex composition between the control and chronic low back pain groups.

items.title: Prognostic value of mNUTRIC and nutritional indices, including early change, for ICU mortality in older adults with AECOPD
items.summary: A single-center retrospective study of 319 older adults with AECOPD found that the mNUTRIC score (AUC 0.852) was a strong independent predictor of ICU mortality. In contrast, the Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI) and its early change (ΔPNI) on day 3 showed limited prognostic value.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在需要 ICU 入住的老年慢阻肺急性加重患者中，基线 mNUTRIC 评分能有效预测 ICU 死亡率，但入院后第三天的 PNI 变化没有额外预后价值。这提示我们在评估患者预后时，应更关注全面的基线营养风险评估。
items.titleZh: mNUTRIC 和营养指数（包括早期变化）对老年慢阻肺急性加重患者 ICU 死亡率的预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 319 名老年慢阻肺急性加重患者的单中心回顾性研究发现，mNUTRIC 评分（AUC 0.852）是 ICU 死亡率的强独立预测因子。相比之下，预后营养指数（PNI）及其第 3 天的早期变化（ΔPNI）显示出有限的预后价值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that the baseline mNUTRIC score effectively predicts ICU mortality in older adults with AECOPD requiring ICU admission, but the PNI change by day 3 offers no additional prognostic value. This suggests a focus on comprehensive baseline nutritional risk assessment when evaluating patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性研究，样本量中等（319 例），且未直接测量衰弱，可能限制了结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective study with a moderate sample size (319 patients) and did not directly measure frailty, potentially limiting the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: A pilot randomized trial of a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program in older adults with heart failure
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 56 older adults with heart failure found a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program (SF-TSTCP) to be feasible and acceptable. The SF-TSTCP improved discharge preparation, transitional care quality, and quality of life at 30 and 90 days post-discharge (p < 0.05), but did not significantly impact readmissions or other health service utilization.
items.curatedReason: 这项小规模随机试验显示，针对心力衰竭老年患者的远程医疗支持过渡期护理项目可行且可接受，并改善了出院准备、护理质量和生活质量。虽然仍是初步结果，但它支持了远程医疗在居家康复中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 一项针对心力衰竭老年患者的以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期护理项目的初步随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 56 名心力衰竭老年患者的初步随机对照试验发现，以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期护理项目（SF-TSTCP）是可行且可接受的。SF-TSTCP 在出院后 30 和 90 天改善了出院准备、过渡期护理质量和生活质量（p < 0.05），但对再入院或其他医疗服务利用没有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small pilot randomized trial demonstrates that a telehealth-supported transitional care program for older adults with heart failure is feasible and acceptable, improving discharge preparation, care quality, and quality of life. While preliminary, these findings support the potential of telehealth in home-based rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点随机试验，样本量较小（56 例），且未显示对再入院率等硬性结局的显著影响，结果需大规模试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary pilot randomized trial with a small sample size (56 patients) and did not show significant impact on hard outcomes like readmission rates, thus results need validation in larger trials.

items.title: Beliefs and Practices of Pediatric Physiotherapists in Türkiye Regarding Early Mobility and Crawling.
items.summary: A survey of 109 pediatric physiotherapists in Türkiye found that 94.5% believed crawling was important for development, and 63% opposed its removal from CDC checklists. These beliefs influenced their clinical practice, with many reporting they would train hands-and-knees crawling.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其 PT 普遍看重爬行在儿童发育中的作用，并倾向于在临床中训练爬行。这提醒我们，在不同文化和实践背景下，对儿童运动发育里程碑的理解和干预策略可能存在差异。
items.titleZh: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师关于早期运动和爬行的信念与实践
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 109 名儿科物理治疗师的调查显示，94.5% 的受访者认为爬行对儿童发育很重要，63% 反对将其从 CDC 发育里程碑清单中删除。这些信念也影响了他们的临床实践，许多人表示会在临床上适当时训练手膝爬行。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turkish PTs widely emphasize the role of crawling in child development and tend to train it clinically. This highlights how understanding and intervention strategies for pediatric motor developmental milestones can vary across cultures and practice contexts.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面在线调查，存在受访者偏差和回忆偏差，且结果仅代表土耳其儿科物理治疗师的观点，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional online survey is subject to respondent and recall bias, and its findings represent only the views of pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Prediction model for timing of independent walking on varied surface conditions in patients with early subacute stroke: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter prospective observational study developed and internally validated a Cox proportional hazards model using six admission predictors to predict the timing of independent walking (FAC 5) on varied surfaces in early subacute stroke patients. The model showed favorable internal performance (AUC 0.86-0.92, calibration slope 0.92).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，基于入院时 6 个预测因子建立的 Cox 模型，在预测亚急性卒中患者何时能实现多变路况下的独立行走（FAC 5）方面，具有一定的内部预测效能（AUC 0.86-0.92）。但这只是初步证据，还需外部验证才能在临床决策中考虑。
items.titleZh: 预测亚急性卒中患者在多变路况下独立行走时间的模型：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心前瞻性观察研究开发并内部验证了一个 Cox 比例风险模型，该模型使用六个入院预测因子，旨在预测亚急性卒中患者在多变路况下实现独立行走 (FAC 5) 的时间。该模型显示出良好的内部预测性能 (AUC 0.86-0.92，校准斜率 0.92)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a Cox model based on 6 admission predictors has some internal predictive power for timing of independent walking (FAC 5) on varied surfaces in subacute stroke patients (AUC 0.86-0.92). However, this is preliminary evidence requiring external validation before clinical consideration.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，且模型仅进行了内部验证，其在更广泛人群中的外部泛化能力尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study, and the model only underwent internal validation; its external generalizability across broader populations remains unverified.

items.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 13 RCTs found telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) for stress urinary incontinence (SUI) to be safe, feasible, and effective, showing comparable efficacy to conventional care and improved accessibility.
items.curatedReason: 远程盆底肌训练 (PFMT) 对压力性尿失禁 (SUI) 患者的安全性和有效性已基本确立，与传统面对面治疗效果相当。你可以更放心地将远程医疗作为 SUI 管理的常规选择，尤其能为地理或物流受限的患者提供支持。
items.titleZh: 压力性尿失禁新型远程康复干预：随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，通过远程医疗提供盆底肌训练 (PFMT) 对压力性尿失禁 (SUI) 女性患者安全、可行且有效，与传统治疗效果相当，并提高了可及性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) for stress urinary incontinence (SUI) is now well-established as safe and effective, with comparable efficacy to traditional in-person care. You can confidently integrate telerehab as a routine option for SUI management, especially for patients with geographical or logistical barriers.
items.limitation: 由于研究间的方法学和临床异质性较高，本系统综述采用叙述性综合而非 Meta 分析。
items.limitationEn: Due to substantial methodological and clinical heterogeneity, the findings were synthesized narratively without meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review on music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and selected music-supported upper-limb programs, with other applications showing potential but requiring more robust research.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述清晰地总结了音乐干预在卒中康复中的应用现状，指出节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最为一致。在将音乐干预纳入临床实践时，你需要明确目标并根据患者偏好进行个性化设置。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中基于音乐的干预：临床应用、机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述发现，节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最为一致，其他应用显示出潜力但需要更坚实的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clearly summarizes the current state of music-based interventions in stroke rehabilitation, noting that rhythmic auditory stimulation for gait and music-supported upper-limb programs have the most consistent evidence. When incorporating music interventions, you should define clear targets and personalize based on patient preference.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未进行正式的偏倚风险评估或定量汇总，可能存在作者选择性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a narrative review, not undertaking formal risk-of-bias assessment or quantitative pooling, which may introduce author-selection bias.

items.title: Low-Level Laser Therapy Versus Mirror Therapy for Post-Stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I: A Randomised Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=44) comparing low-level laser therapy (LLLT) and mirror therapy (MT) for post-stroke CRPS-I found LLLT provided an early significant advantage at 4 weeks in pain reduction (p=0.039) and sensorimotor recovery (p=0.022), but no significant long-term difference between groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 首次比较了低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 和镜像疗法 (MT) 在卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I) 中的效果。结果提示 LLLT 在早期（4 周）可能在疼痛缓解和感觉运动恢复方面有优势，但长期来看两种疗法效果相当。在初期治疗策略选择时，可以考虑 LLLT。
items.titleZh: 低能量激光疗法对比镜像疗法治疗卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 I 型：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=44）比较了低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 和镜像疗法 (MT) 在卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I) 中的效果，发现在 4 周时 LLLT 在疼痛减轻 (p=0.039) 和感觉运动恢复 (p=0.022) 方面显示出早期显著优势，但长期来看两组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to compare low-level laser therapy (LLLT) and mirror therapy (MT) for post-stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I (CRPS-I). It suggests LLLT may offer an early advantage (4 weeks) in pain reduction and sensorimotor recovery, though long-term outcomes are comparable. Consider LLLT in initial treatment planning.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=44)，且随访时间相对较短 (12 周)。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=44) and a short follow-up period (12 weeks).
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990, revealing the influence of the Repetitive Strain Injury epidemic, barriers in conventional education and legislation, and physiotherapists' adaptability.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究描绘了 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展历程，揭示了 RSI 疫情、传统教育和立法障碍，以及行业适应性如何塑造了这一专业领域。你可以借此了解该领域在澳大利亚的发展脉络。
items.titleZh: 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，揭示了重复性劳损 (RSI) 疫情的影响、传统教育和立法障碍，以及物理治疗师的适应能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study outlines the development of Australian occupational health physiotherapy from 1970-1990, highlighting the impact of the RSI epidemic, educational and legislative barriers, and the profession's adaptability. Use this to understand the historical context of the field in Australia.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且仅限于通过访谈回顾历史经验，可能存在回忆偏倚和主观性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and relies on retrospective interviews, which may introduce recall bias and subjectivity.

items.title: Low levels of physical activity and high amount of sedentary behavior in the acute phase after stroke.
items.summary: A study (n=95) found acute stroke patients exhibited low physical activity (steps/day increased from 2844 to 4970) and high sedentary behavior (22.7 to 21.1 hours/day) from hospitalization to 7-days post-discharge, despite some improvements post-discharge.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究量化了卒中急性期患者身体活动水平普遍偏低、久坐行为普遍偏高的情况。这提示你在急性期康复中，需要更主动地干预和鼓励患者增加身体活动，并制定策略减少久坐时间。
items.titleZh: 卒中急性期身体活动水平低，久坐行为多
items.summaryZh: 一项对 95 名患者的研究发现，卒中急性期患者从住院到出院后 7 天，身体活动水平仍然较低（步数从 2844 增加到 4970 步/天），久坐行为较多（从 22.7 减少到 21.1 小时/天），尽管出院后有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study quantifies the persistently low physical activity and high sedentary behavior in acute stroke patients. This suggests a need for more proactive interventions during acute rehabilitation to encourage physical activity and strategies to reduce sedentary time.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，可能存在选择偏倚，且结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study, which may be subject to selection bias and have limited generalizability.

items.title: Fatigue-related neuromuscular outcomes following ACL reconstruction: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 17 studies (n=477) found that individuals with ACLR demonstrated lower post-fatigue quadriceps CAR (SMD: -0.69, p < 0.001) and muscle activation patterns (SMD: -0.62, p < 0.001) compared to healthy controls, with moderate certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）后，患者在疲劳状态下，股四头肌中央激活比（CAR）和肌肉激活的损伤更为显著。这再次强调了在重返运动评估中加入疲劳测试的重要性，因为它可能比静态表现更能揭示功能缺陷。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后疲劳相关神经肌肉结局：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 17 项研究（n=477）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与健康对照组相比，前交叉韧带重建术后的个体在疲劳后股四头肌中央激活比（SMD: -0.69, p < 0.001）和肌肉激活模式（SMD: -0.62, p < 0.001）方面表现出更低的水平，证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Following ACL reconstruction (ACLR), individuals demonstrate greater post-fatigue impairments in quadriceps central activation ratio (CAR) and muscle activation. This re-emphasizes the importance of incorporating fatigue testing into return-to-sport assessments, as it may reveal functional deficits more accurately than static performance.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究设计多为非随机，且结局指标异质性高，影响了证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were mostly non-randomized, and outcome measures exhibited high heterogeneity, impacting the certainty of evidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Motor-Based Interventions in Children with Developmental Coordination Disorder: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials - Sports Medicine - Open
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 32 RCTs found that motor-based interventions (MBI) significantly improved overall motor skills (g=1.00), balance (g=0.57), cognitive (g=1.53), and activity performance (g=0.71) in children with DCD. Task-oriented training showed particular effectiveness, but MBI did not significantly improve psychosocial factors or participation levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述肯定了运动干预（MBI）能显著改善发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童的运动技能、身体功能和活动表现。其中，任务导向训练和结合任务与过程导向的训练尤其有效。但在社会心理和参与度方面，MBI 效果不明显，这提示我们康复方案应考虑这些方面进行补充。
items.titleZh: 发育性协调障碍儿童的运动干预：随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 32 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，运动干预（MBI）显著改善了发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童的整体运动技能（g=1.00）、平衡（g=0.57）、认知（g=1.53）和活动表现（g=0.71）。任务导向训练显示出特别的有效性，但 MBI 未能显著改善社会心理因素或参与水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review affirms that motor-based interventions (MBI) significantly improve motor skills, body functions, and activity performance in children with Developmental Coordination Disorder (DCD), with task-oriented and combined task/process-oriented training being particularly effective. However, MBI showed no significant effects on psychosocial factors or participation levels, suggesting the need to supplement rehabilitation plans in these areas.
items.limitation: 部分结局（如社会心理因素和参与水平）的证据因研究数量有限而不够充分。
items.limitationEn: Evidence for some outcomes (e.g., psychosocial factors and participation levels) was limited due to a restricted number of studies.

items.title: Single-bundle versus double-bundle reconstruction in anterior cruciate ligament: a meta-analysis
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 41 RCTs (n=3,568) found that DB ACL reconstruction showed statistically higher rates of negative pivot-shift test (short-term OR=0.62, p<0.001; long-term OR=0.37, p=0.007) and higher long-term Lysholm scores (MD=-1.32, p=0.004) compared to SB, but no clinically meaningful superiority for most patients.
items.curatedReason: 关于前交叉韧带（ACL）重建，单束（SB）与双束（DB）技术之争，这项荟萃分析发现 DB 技术在特定的客观稳定性参数和长期 Lysholm 评分上统计学显著优于 SB，但在大多数患者中不具临床意义。短期而言，SB 仍是可靠选择，外科医生应基于患者需求和经验个体化决策。
items.titleZh: 单束与双束重建在前交叉韧带修复中的比较：荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 41 项随机对照试验（n=3,568）的荟萃分析发现，与单束（SB）重建相比，双束（DB）前交叉韧带重建在枢轴移位试验阴性率（短期 OR=0.62, p<0.001; 长期 OR=0.37, p=0.007）和长期 Lysholm 评分（MD=-1.32, p=0.004）上统计学显著更高，但对于大多数患者而言，并无临床意义上的优越性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Regarding ACL reconstruction, this meta-analysis on single-bundle (SB) versus double-bundle (DB) techniques found that DB statistically improved specific objective stability parameters and long-term Lysholm scores, but without clinical meaningfulness for most patients. SB remains a reliable short-term option, and surgeons should individualize decisions based on patient needs and experience.
items.limitation: 研究在短长期 KT-1000/2000 侧向差异和短期的 Lysholm 评分中存在中高异质性，影响结果解释。
items.limitationEn: The study showed moderate to high heterogeneity in short- and long-term KT-1000/2000 side-to-side differences and short-term Lysholm scores, affecting interpretation.

items.title: Effects of adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training on kinematics, centers of pressure, and proprioception in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training significantly improved proprioception (p=0.001, η²=0.34 for joint position sense error), mediolateral center of pressure displacement (p=0.001, η²=0.42), and ankle kinematics in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者，在抗阻-平衡训练中加入带视觉反馈的步态再训练，能显著改善本体感觉、步态中的压力中心和踝关节运动学。这为临床实践中提升CAI康复效果提供了明确的方向。
items.titleZh: 在慢性踝关节不稳患者的抗阻-平衡训练中加入带视觉反馈的步态再训练对运动学、压力中心和本体感觉的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）发现，在慢性踝关节不稳患者的抗阻-平衡训练中加入带视觉反馈的步态再训练，能显著改善本体感觉（关节位置感误差 p=0.001, η²=0.34）、内外侧压力中心位移（p=0.001, η²=0.42）和踝关节运动学。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability (CAI), adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training significantly improves proprioception, center of pressure during walking, and ankle kinematics. This provides a clear direction for enhancing CAI rehabilitation outcomes in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 样本量相对较小（n=45），且研究未评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The sample size is relatively small (n=45), and the study did not evaluate long-term effects.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Precision rehabilitation, from foundational concepts to contemporary perspectives: a mixed-methods scoping review
items.summary: A mixed-methods scoping review of 49 articles and 16 knowledge user interviews identified that precision rehabilitation shares similarities with precision medicine but uniquely emphasizes personalization, function, and participation. Technology and AI are integral, though limited AI use is noted due to concerns about psychosocial factors and population heterogeneity.
items.curatedReason: 精确康复（Precision Rehabilitation）不是精确医疗的翻版。这份综述明确了康复领域独有的重点是功能和参与度。尽管AI和技术是其核心，但AI的有限应用提示我们，在未来实践中仍需关注心理社会因素和人群异质性。
items.titleZh: 精确康复：从基本概念到当代视角：一项混合方法范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 49 篇文章和 16 次知识用户访谈的混合方法范围综述发现，精确康复与精确医疗有相似之处，但独特地强调个性化、功能和参与。技术和人工智能是其重要组成部分，但人工智能的使用有限，原因是担心社会心理因素和人群异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Precision Rehabilitation isn't just a rehash of precision medicine. This review clarifies rehabilitation's unique emphasis on function and participation. While technology and AI are integral, limited AI use highlights the ongoing need to consider psychosocial factors and population heterogeneity in future practice.
items.limitation: 研究主要基于文献综述和知识用户访谈，缺少实际临床应用的效果评估。
items.limitationEn: The study is primarily based on literature review and knowledge user interviews, lacking evaluation of actual clinical application effectiveness.

items.title: Development of a telerehabilitation-based exercise and monitoring program and its effectiveness compared with a brochure-based home exercise program in patients with lumbar disc herniation: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=46) found that both telerehabilitation and brochure-based home exercise programs were effective for lumbar disc herniation. Telerehabilitation showed greater improvement in activity-related pain (p=0.027) and dynamic lumbar muscle performance (p=0.031) after adjustment for baseline values.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复在腰椎间盘突出症患者的疼痛和肌肉功能改善方面，可能比传统小册子居家锻炼有额外益处。如果你正在考虑为患者提供远程干预，这项研究提示了其在活动相关疼痛和动态腰部肌肉表现上的优势。
items.titleZh: 远程康复运动监测计划与小册子居家锻炼计划对腰椎间盘突出症患者有效性的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=46）发现，远程康复和基于小册子的居家锻炼计划均能有效改善腰椎间盘突出症患者的症状。调整基线值后，远程康复在活动相关疼痛（p=0.027）和动态腰部肌肉表现（p=0.031）方面显示出更大的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation may offer additional benefits over traditional brochure-based home exercise programs for improving pain and muscle function in patients with lumbar disc herniation. If you're considering remote interventions for your patients, this study suggests advantages in activity-related pain and dynamic lumbar muscle performance.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=46），且在基线时两组动态腰部肌肉表现存在显著差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=46), and there was a significant baseline difference in dynamic lumbar muscle performance between the two groups.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Health-convergence-based muscle synergy variability for quantifying neuromuscular control responses evoked by upper limb rehabilitation robot training in stroke patients
items.summary: This study (n=62 stroke patients) developed a health-convergence-based muscle synergy variability index (Vvariability) to quantify neuromuscular control during upper limb robot training. Vvariability significantly reduced after 4 weeks across assistive (5.7%-11.2%), active (13.2%-25.5%), and resistive (14.0%-25.1%) training, correlating negatively with FMA-UE scores.
items.curatedReason: 新提出的肌肉协同变异性指数（Vvariability）在卒中患者上肢机器人训练中显示出潜力。它在辅助、主动和抗阻训练后均显著下降，并与FMA-UE评分呈负相关，提示该指标能更精细地量化神经肌肉控制改善，超越传统临床量表。
items.titleZh: 基于健康收敛的肌肉协同变异性量化卒中患者上肢康复机器人训练诱发的神经肌肉控制反应
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（62 名卒中患者）开发了一种基于健康收敛的肌肉协同变异性指数（Vvariability），用于量化上肢机器人训练期间的神经肌肉控制。经 4 周训练后，Vvariability 在辅助（5.7%-11.2%）、主动（13.2%-25.5%）和抗阻（14.0%-25.1%）组中均显著降低，并与 FMA-UE 评分呈负相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The new Vvariability index shows promise in quantifying neuromuscular control during upper limb robot training for stroke patients. Its significant reduction post-training (5.7%-25.5% across modes) and negative correlation with FMA-UE scores suggest it offers a more nuanced measure of improvement than traditional clinical scales.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（n=62），且未报告长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (n=62) and did not report long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Biomechanical mechanisms of manipulative reduction for pediatric type II atlantoaxial subluxation a finite element analysis with neurocentral synchondroses
items.summary: A finite element analysis of a 6-year-old pediatric craniocervical model found that type II atlantoaxial subluxation increases stress throughout the cervical spine. During simulated rotational manipulation, the transverse ligament (2.37 MPa), capsular ligament (3.09 MPa), and odontoid process were identified as high-risk structures.
items.curatedReason: 这项有限元分析揭示了儿科寰枢椎脱位 II 型手法复位时，横韧带、关节囊韧带和齿突是高风险结构。这为操作者提供了重要的生物力学证据，以评估手法复位的安全性，并提醒你对儿童患者进行这类操作时需格外谨慎。
items.titleZh: 小儿 II 型寰枢椎半脱位手法复位的生物力学机制：含神经中心软骨结合的有限元分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 6 岁儿童颅颈模型的有限元分析发现，II 型寰枢椎半脱位增加了整个颈椎的应力。在模拟的旋转手法复位过程中，横韧带（2.37 MPa）、关节囊韧带（3.09 MPa）和齿突被确定为高风险结构。
items.curatedReasonEn: This finite element analysis reveals that the transverse ligament, capsular ligament, and odontoid process are high-risk structures during manipulative reduction for pediatric type II atlantoaxial subluxation. This provides crucial biomechanical evidence for operators to assess the safety of manual reduction and emphasizes extreme caution when performing such procedures on pediatric patients.
items.limitation: 本研究是计算机模拟分析，需要临床验证其结果的真实性和普适性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a computer simulation analysis, and its results require clinical validation for authenticity and generalizability.

items.title: Co-design of a wheelchair-mounted robotic arm for functional autonomy: a Cybathlon case study in user-driven assistive robotics
items.summary: This single-case co-design study, involving a 32-year-old C5–C6 spinal cord injury patient preparing for the Cybathlon, demonstrated that sustained co-design of a wheelchair-mounted robotic arm can support robust assistive manipulation, achieving competitive task performance and low failure rates.
items.curatedReason: Cybathlon 的案例研究展示了通过与 C5–C6 脊髓损伤患者共同设计轮椅式机械臂，能够提高其功能自主性。虽然这是一个单案例研究，但它突显了以用户为中心的协同设计方法在辅助技术开发中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 基于健康收敛的肌肉协同变异性量化卒中患者上肢康复机器人训练诱发的神经肌肉控制反应
items.summaryZh: 这项单案例共同设计研究，涉及一名 32 岁 C5-C6 脊髓损伤患者备战 Cybathlon，结果表明持续的共同设计轮椅式机械臂可以支持稳健的辅助操作，实现有竞争力的任务表现和低故障率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Cybathlon case study demonstrates that co-designing a wheelchair-mounted robotic arm with a C5–C6 spinal cord injury patient can enhance functional autonomy. While a single-case study, it highlights the potential of user-centered co-design in assistive technology development.
items.limitation: 本研究是一个单案例的共同设计研究，结果不具普遍性，无法建立普遍的可用性或长期采纳性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-case co-design study, and its results are not generalizable; it cannot establish general usability or long-term adoption.

items.title: Supportive Strides: Co-designing Community-Based Walking Programs with Embedded Socialisation and Peer Support for People after Stroke
items.summary: Researchers co-designed a community-based walking program called 'Supportive Strides' for stroke survivors, integrating social connection, peer support, and inclusive environments, informed by feedback from 26 participants (12 stroke survivors, 2 carers, 12 professionals).
items.curatedReason: 卒中后社区步行项目设计需要高度融合社交支持和同伴互动。这项共同设计的研究展示了如何将这些元素纳入方案，对未来实施类似项目有参考价值。
items.titleZh: 支持性步伐：与卒中患者共同设计嵌入社交和同伴支持的社区步行项目
items.summaryZh: 研究人员与 26 名参与者（包括 12 名卒中幸存者）共同设计了“支持性步伐”社区步行项目，旨在通过整合社交联系和同伴支持，提高卒中后的身体活动水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: Community-based walking programs post-stroke benefit from high integration of social support and peer interaction. This co-design study demonstrates how to incorporate these elements, providing a valuable blueprint for implementing similar programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为项目共同设计阶段，尚未进行干预测试和效果评估。
items.limitationEn: This study is in the program co-design phase and has not yet evaluated intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Vestibular rehabilitation therapy in Turkey: insights into physical therapists' clinical practice.
items.summary: A survey of 178 licensed physical therapists in Turkey revealed significant gaps in their knowledge, beliefs, and clinical practices regarding vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT), with 88.8% having no VRT experience and over 60% unfamiliar with key techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项土耳其调研揭示了当地物理治疗师在前庭康复治疗（VRT）知识和实践方面的显著差距。如果你在美国或澳洲执业，这篇研究的直接参考意义不大，但侧面提醒你在评估自己国家 VRT 培训和实践时，可能也有类似机会。
items.titleZh: 土耳其的前庭康复治疗：物理治疗师临床实践洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 178 名执业物理治疗师的调查显示，他们在前庭康复治疗（VRT）的知识、信念和临床实践方面存在显著差距，其中 88.8% 的人没有 VRT 经验，超过 60% 的人不熟悉关键技术。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Turkish survey reveals significant gaps in physical therapists' knowledge and practice of vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT) in the region. While its direct relevance to US or Australian practice may be limited, it serves as a reminder to assess similar opportunities in VRT training and practice within your own country.
items.limitation: 本研究是针对土耳其物理治疗师的横断面调查，结果存在地域局限性，且无法推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey of Turkish physical therapists, with regionally specific results and no causal inferences.

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (n=24) investigated high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) for plantar flexor spasticity in subacute and chronic stroke patients, finding significant reductions in spasticity-related pain and a small covariate-adjusted gait speed benefit, but no change in spasticity or muscle thickness.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光疗法（HILT）作为卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的辅助治疗，在本初步试验中显示出减轻痉挛相关疼痛的潜力，并可能对步态速度有小幅改善。但在广泛推荐之前，需等待更大样本量、更有力的研究确认其临床效用。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法对亚急性期和慢性期卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛的功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=24）评估了高强度激光疗法（HILT）对亚急性期和慢性期卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛的疗效。研究发现 HILT 能显著减轻痉挛相关疼痛，并伴有小幅、经协变量调整后的步态速度改善，但对痉挛或肌肉厚度无影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) shows potential for reducing spasticity-related pain and possibly a small gait speed benefit as an adjunct for plantar flexor spasticity in stroke patients, as indicated by this preliminary trial. However, larger, more robust studies are needed to confirm its clinical utility before widespread recommendation.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步试验，样本量小（24 人），激光对步态速度的益处在临床意义上仍不确定，且未观察到痉挛或肌肉厚度的改善。
items.limitationEn: This was a preliminary trial with a small sample size (n=24), the clinical significance of the gait speed benefit is uncertain, and no improvements in spasticity or muscle thickness were observed.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy for adhesive capsulitis resulted in statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM, with a 14.08° increase in abduction, but pain and disability changes did not reach MCID thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于肩周炎，神经松动术结合 PNF 和常规物理治疗，短期内能带来统计学显著的肩关节活动度（外展增加 14.08°）改善，但疼痛和功能障碍的临床意义不明显。在纳入常规方案前，仍需更多研究验证其长期临床效益。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术结合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术对肩周炎患者的附加价值：随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=56）显示，神经松动术结合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术及常规物理治疗，能显著改善肩周炎患者的疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度，肩外展增加 14.08°，但疼痛和功能障碍的改善未达临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that for adhesive capsulitis, combining neural mobilization techniques with PNF and conventional physical therapy can lead to statistically significant short-term improvements in shoulder ROM (abduction increased by 14.08°), but clinically meaningful benefits for pain and disability are not clear. Further research is needed to validate long-term clinical efficacy before incorporating it into routine protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（56 人），随访期短（6 周），且疼痛和功能障碍的改善未达到临床最小重要差异（MCID），表明实际临床效益有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=56) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks); improvements in pain and disability did not meet the MCID, indicating limited practical clinical benefit.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=40) in subacute stroke patients found that sequential electroacupuncture combined with augmented reality gait training significantly improved gait speed (Wald χ²=6.509, P=0.011), stride length, gait symmetry, motor function, and balance compared to AR alone after 4 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT有力支持了在亚急性卒中患者步态训练中，顺序电针结合AR训练的增效作用。电针预处理能显著提高步速、步长、步态对称性和平衡功能。建议您在临床实践中考虑这种联合干预方案，尤其是针对步态功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 顺序电针结合增强现实步态训练对亚急性卒中患者步行功能和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对40名亚急性卒中患者的单盲随机对照试验显示，顺序电针结合增强现实步态训练在4周后显著改善了步速（Wald χ²=6.509, P=0.011）、步长、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡，优于单独AR训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT strongly supports the additive effect of sequential electroacupuncture combined with AR gait training in subacute stroke patients. Electroacupuncture pre-treatment significantly improves gait speed, stride length, gait symmetry, and balance. Consider this combined intervention in your clinical practice, especially for gait function recovery.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（n=40），且随访期较短，长期效果和机制需进一步研究证实。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (n=40) and short follow-up period mean long-term effects and mechanisms require further confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This commentary critically examines traditional, reductionist models in sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for an integrated, complexity-informed framework. It redefines evidence-based practice and the biopsychosocial model to support patient-centered and contextually relevant physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒我们，运动损伤的康复和预防不能简单地依赖线性和还原论框架。它强调了将复杂性科学、整合的循证实践以及动态的生物心理社会模型融入临床实践的重要性，以实现更个性化、背景敏感的治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实生活中失效时：重新思考运动损伤康复与预防
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评批判性审视了运动损伤预防与康复中的传统还原论模型，提倡整合复杂性科学、循证实践和动态生物心理社会模型，以支持以患者为中心、与情境相关的物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds us that sports injury rehabilitation and prevention cannot solely rely on linear, reductionist frameworks. It emphasizes the importance of integrating complexity science, a holistic view of evidence-based practice, and a dynamic biopsychosocial model into clinical practice for more personalized, context-sensitive treatment approaches.

items.title: Physical dependence, self-efficacy, and resilience in stroke patients: a double-moderated mediation model of healthcare group and pre-stroke employment.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=123) found that greater physical dependence in stroke patients is concurrently associated with lower resilience, a relationship partially mediated by lower self-efficacy. This conditional indirect pathway was particularly pronounced in the routine care group among patients unemployed prior to stroke onset.
items.curatedReason: 本横断面研究提示，卒中患者的躯体依赖程度与复原力负相关，这种关系部分由自我效能介导。对接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者，这一负相关尤为明显。应将患者的就业史和社会角色纳入康复策略，以支持其心理社会适应。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者的躯体依赖、自我效能和复原力：医疗组与卒中前就业的双重调节中介模型
items.summaryZh: 一项对123名卒中患者的横断面研究显示，躯体依赖程度与复原力负相关，其中自我效能发挥部分中介作用。尤其在接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者中，这种条件性间接路径更为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study suggests that physical dependence is negatively associated with resilience in stroke patients, partially mediated by self-efficacy. This negative correlation is particularly pronounced in patients receiving routine care who were unemployed pre-stroke. Incorporate patients' employment history and social roles into rehabilitation strategies to support their psychosocial adaptation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小（n=123），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality and its small sample size (n=123) limits generalizability.

items.title: Quantitative evaluation of shoulder motor compensation in stroke patients based on multimodal feature analysis.
items.summary: This study validated a multimodal approach combining markerless motion capture and sEMG to quantitatively assess shoulder motor compensation in 25 stroke patients. Kinematic (Maximum Joint Angle, ρ=0.932, p<0.001) and electromyographic (Median Frequency, ρ=0.806, p<0.001) features showed strong correlations with traditional clinical scales, effectively distinguishing different motor recovery stages.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中患者肩关节代偿的评估，你现在有了除传统临床量表外的一种新选择。这项包含 25 名患者的研究提示，无标记动作捕捉和表面肌电图结合的方法，在运动学（ρ=0.932）和肌电图（ρ=0.806）指标上，与现有量表高度相关，并能区分不同恢复阶段。未来，你或许可以考虑用这种客观方法来辅助优化康复方案。
items.titleZh: 基于多模态特征分析的卒中患者肩关节运动代偿定量评估
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过结合无标记动作捕捉和表面肌电图，对 25 名卒中患者的肩关节运动代偿进行了定量评估。运动学特征（最大关节角度，ρ=0.932，p<0.001）和肌电图特征（中位频率，ρ=0.806，p<0.001）与传统临床量表显示出强相关性，有效区分了不同运动恢复阶段。
items.curatedReasonEn: You now have a potential new option for assessing shoulder compensation in stroke patients beyond traditional clinical scales. This 25-patient study suggests that combining markerless motion capture and sEMG yields kinematic (ρ=0.932) and electromyographic (ρ=0.806) metrics highly correlated with existing scales, and can differentiate recovery stages. In the future, you might consider using this objective approach to help optimize rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=25），且仅关注了肩关节外展这一单一任务，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=25) and focuses on a single task (shoulder abduction), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 inpatients with new disabilities (stroke, SCI, amputation) found 43% desired exposure to adaptive sports during rehabilitation. Younger age (P<0.01) and pre-admission sports participation (P<0.05) correlated positively with this desire.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了急性康复阶段的新发残疾患者对适应性运动的强烈兴趣，特别是年轻患者和入院前有运动史的患者。这提示在院内早期介绍适应性运动对患者未来参与有积极影响。
items.titleZh: 住院康复期间适应性运动介绍：一项描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名新发残疾住院患者（卒中、脊髓损伤、截肢）的横断面研究发现，43% 的患者希望在康复期间接触适应性运动。年轻（P<0.01）和入院前有运动史（P<0.05）与此愿望呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals significant interest in adaptive sports among patients with new disabilities during acute rehabilitation, especially younger patients and those with a history of pre-admission sports participation. This suggests that early introduction of adaptive sports during inpatient stays positively influences future participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面描述性研究，无法建立因果关系，且基于自我报告的问卷调查可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional descriptive study cannot establish causality, and self-reported survey data may be subject to recall bias.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke.
items.summary: This study protocol outlines a randomized, assessor-blinded, two-period, two-sequence crossover trial to compare Swiss ball balance training and conventional balance training in subacute stroke patients over six weeks. The trial aims to assess improvements in trunk control, balance, and mobility, with expected greater gains from Swiss ball exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究是 RCT 方案，而非最终结果，所以现在还不需要改变你的临床实践。如果未来研究证实瑞士球训练对亚急性卒中患者在躯干控制、平衡和活动能力上有优势，尤其是在资源有限的情况下，那么你将多一个可考虑的干预方案。在此之前，我们仍需等待其真实数据。
items.titleZh: 比较瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者躯干控制和活动能力改善效果的随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项随机、评估者盲法、两周期、两序列交叉试验，旨在比较瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者的影响，干预期为六周。该试验旨在评估躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的改善，预计瑞士球训练会带来更大的获益。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an RCT protocol, not final results, so no immediate change to your clinical practice is needed. Should future findings confirm superior gains in trunk control, balance, and mobility for subacute stroke patients using Swiss ball training, especially in resource-limited settings, you'll have an additional intervention option to consider. Until then, we await the actual data.
items.limitation: 本研究方案尚未执行，为一项试验方案，最终结果和临床有效性仍待验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a protocol that has not yet been executed; the final results and clinical effectiveness are still pending validation.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training on lower-leg neuromuscular function in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (N=60) found that neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training, when added to an 8-week exercise program for chronic ankle instability, yielded higher FAAM-Sports scores than exercise alone and NMES alone, but not BFRT alone. The combined intervention also showed broader favorable changes in secondary outcomes, particularly peroneus longus activation and eversion strength, though not consistently across all outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在标准化运动方案中联合使用神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT），比单独运动或单一模式可能带来更广泛的短期益处，尤其是在腓骨长肌激活和外翻力量方面。但也要注意，这种联合干预并非在所有结果上都表现出一致优势。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合血流限制训练对慢性踝关节不稳患者小腿神经肌肉功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（N=60）发现，对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在8周运动方案中加入神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合血流限制训练（BFRT），能比单独运动或单独NMES带来更高的FAAM-Sports评分，但与单独BFRT无显著差异。联合干预在腓骨长肌激活和外翻力量等次要结局指标上也显示出更广泛的有利变化，但并非在所有结果上都保持一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability, combining neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with a standardized exercise program may offer broader short-term benefits than exercise alone or isolated modalities, especially in peroneus longus activation and eversion strength. However, this combined intervention does not show consistent advantages across all outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=60），随访期短（8周），且是单中心研究，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=60) and a short follow-up period (8 weeks), and is a single-center study, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Rotational perturbation training improves muscle coordination during reactive standing balance in trained and untrained conditions in children with spastic cerebral palsy.
items.summary: This longitudinal intervention study (N=14 children with CP, N=10 typically developing children) found that rotational perturbation training improved reactive standing balance and decreased muscle co-activation in children with spastic cerebral palsy. The training-induced adaptations generalized to untrained translational perturbations, suggesting modifiable balance control through perturbation training.
items.curatedReason: 这项干预研究发现，旋转扰动训练能有效改善痉挛性脑瘫儿童的反应性站立平衡能力和肌肉协调性，并且这种改善可以泛化到未经训练的扰动条件。这意味着你可以在儿童脑瘫的平衡训练中，考虑引入多样化的扰动训练，以促进更广泛的功能性适应。
items.titleZh: 旋转扰动训练改善痉挛性脑瘫儿童在训练和非训练条件下的反应性站立平衡肌肉协调性
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向干预研究（N=14名痉挛性脑瘫儿童，N=10名正常发育儿童）发现，旋转扰动训练改善了痉挛性脑瘫儿童的反应性站立平衡能力并降低了肌肉共同激活。训练引起的适应性泛化到未经训练的平移扰动，提示通过扰动训练可以改变平衡控制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This intervention study found that rotational perturbation training effectively improves reactive standing balance and muscle coordination in children with spastic cerebral palsy, and this improvement generalizes to untrained perturbation conditions. This suggests you can consider incorporating diverse perturbation training into balance interventions for children with cerebral palsy to promote broader functional adaptations.
items.limitation: 这是一个纵向干预研究，而非随机对照试验，且样本量较小（脑瘫儿童N=14，TD儿童N=10），缺乏对照组比较，结果存在偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This is a longitudinal intervention study, not a randomized controlled trial, with a small sample size (N=14 for CP children, N=10 for TD children), and lacks a control group comparison, posing a risk of bias.

items.title: Recent clinical practice guidelines for the management of low back pain: a global comparison
items.summary: This review identified 22 recent clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) for low back pain (LBP) from 2017 to 2022. It found significant heterogeneity in recommendations across guidelines, particularly for different stages of LBP, though common recommendations for acute, subacute, and chronic LBP included therapeutic exercise, NSAIDs, and spinal manipulation.
items.curatedReason: 对全球最新的22项腰痛临床实践指南的比较显示，不同指南在干预推荐上存在显著异质性。这意味着在处理腰痛时，你不能盲目照搬某一指南，而应批判性地审视其证据基础，并结合患者具体情况和执业环境灵活应用。
items.titleZh: 近期下腰痛管理临床实践指南：一项全球比较
items.summaryZh: 这项综述确定了2017年至2022年间的22份近期下腰痛（LBP）临床实践指南。研究发现，不同指南在推荐方面存在显著异质性，尤其针对LBP的不同阶段，但急性和慢性LBP的常见推荐包括治疗性运动、非甾体抗炎药和脊柱手法治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: A comparison of 22 recent global LBP clinical practice guidelines reveals significant heterogeneity in recommended interventions. This means you shouldn't blindly follow a single guideline; instead, critically evaluate its evidence base and apply it flexibly, considering your patient's specific circumstances and practice environment.
items.limitation: 本综述仅分析了22份指南，且评估工具 AGREE II 仅能评估方法学质量，不能直接评价推荐的临床有效性。
items.limitationEn: This review only analyzed 22 guidelines, and the AGREE II tool only assesses methodological quality, not the clinical effectiveness of the recommendations.

items.title: Educational Videos Were Not Superior to a Folder in Improving Urinary Incontinence Knowledge and Symptoms: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This single-blinded, parallel-group RCT (N=75) found that a remote health education program combining WhatsApp-delivered educational videos and an educational folder was not superior to the folder alone in improving urinary incontinence knowledge (95% CI −1.38 to 0.52), symptoms (95% CI −2.20 to 1.83), or severity (95% CI −1.37; 0.89) in incontinent women with high baseline knowledge.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对于已知盆底肌训练（PFMT）和尿失禁知识的患者，额外通过 WhatsApp 发送教育视频，在改善尿失禁知识、症状或严重程度上，并不优于单独的纸质教育手册。这意味着在已经提供了基础信息和盆底训练指导后，单纯增加视频形式的远程宣教可能效益有限，你应将资源用于更有效的干预手段。
items.titleZh: 教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面不优于纸质手册：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项单盲平行组随机对照试验（N=75）发现，对于基线知识水平较高的尿失禁女性，结合WhatsApp教育视频和纸质手册的远程健康教育项目，在改善尿失禁知识（95% CI −1.38 to 0.52）、症状（95% CI −2.20 to 1.83）或严重程度（95% CI −1.37; 0.89）方面，并不比单独使用纸质手册更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that for patients already familiar with pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) and urinary incontinence (UI) knowledge, additional educational videos via WhatsApp did not show superior effectiveness in improving UI knowledge, symptoms, or severity compared to a paper-based educational folder alone. This suggests that simply adding video-based remote education might have limited benefits once basic information and PFMT guidance are provided, prompting you to allocate resources to more impactful interventions.
items.limitation: 研究对象为已知有高水平尿失禁相关知识且基线已患中度尿失禁的女性，结果不一定能外推至其他知识水平或疾病严重程度的患者。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were women with high baseline knowledge of urinary incontinence and moderate UI severity, so the results may not be generalizable to patients with different knowledge levels or disease severity.

items.title: Therapists’ perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.summary: This qualitative descriptive study explored the perspectives of 5 physical therapists and 4 physical therapy assistants on using an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions with 10 minimally ambulatory children (GMFCS Level IV, 4-6 years) with cerebral palsy. Therapists perceived exoskeletons as a valuable adjunct to conventional therapy, enhancing exercise options, inclusion, and autonomy, but identified new clinical skills, added resources, and individualized goal-based thinking as implementation challenges.
items.curatedReason: 下肢外骨骼被治疗师视为辅助脑瘫儿童康复的有用工具，能增加锻炼选择并提升参与度，但请注意，这只是对传统治疗的补充，而非替代。实施时，你需要考虑额外的人力、技能培训和资源投入，并牢记需以儿童的个体目标为导向。
items.titleZh: 治疗师对在物理治疗中使用下肢外骨骼辅助低活动度脑瘫儿童的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性描述性研究探讨了5名物理治疗师和4名物理治疗助理在使用下肢外骨骼辅助10名低活动度（GMFCS IV级，4-6岁）脑瘫儿童进行物理治疗时的看法。治疗师认为外骨骼是传统疗法的有益补充，可增加运动选择、包容性和自主性，但也指出实施中面临新临床技能、额外资源和个性化目标导向思维等挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb exoskeletons are viewed by therapists as a valuable adjunct for pediatric cerebral palsy rehabilitation, enhancing exercise options and participation. However, remember they supplement, not replace, traditional therapy. Implementation requires considering additional staffing, skill training, and resources, always prioritizing individualized, goal-based thinking for the child.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（N=5名PT，N=4名PTA），结果基于治疗师的感知，不提供量化的临床效果，且未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (N=5 PTs, N=4 PTAs). The results are based on therapist perceptions and do not provide quantified clinical outcomes, and the preprint has not been certified by peer review.

items.title: Evidence-Based Insights for the Development and Talent Promotion of Young Athletes in a National Sports Context
items.summary: This perspective article examines the challenges and opportunities in integrating early talent promotion with sustainable athlete development frameworks, using the Swedish context as a case study. It argues for nuanced, evidence-based youth sport systems that support both elite performance and broader participation goals, emphasizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了青年运动员早期人才选拔与长期可持续发展之间的微妙平衡。作为康复治疗师，它提示我们应倡导建立一个更注重运动员整体福祉和内在动力的系统，但请注意，这更多是宏观政策层面的讨论，对你的日常临床决策没有直接指导意义。
items.titleZh: 国家体育背景下青年运动员发展与人才培养的循证见解
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章以瑞典为例，探讨了早期人才培养与可持续运动员发展框架相结合的挑战和机遇。文章主张采用细致入微的循证青年体育体系，同时支持精英表现和更广泛的参与目标，并强调运动员福祉和内在动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the delicate balance between early talent identification and sustainable long-term development in youth athletes. As a rehab therapist, it prompts us to advocate for systems prioritizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation. However, note that this is a macro-level policy discussion with limited direct guidance for your daily clinical decisions.

items.title: Effects of flywheel training on post-activation performance enhancement in male basketball players
items.summary: This exploratory crossover study (N=20) investigated the acute effects of flywheel half-squat conditioning on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in collegiate male basketball players using different inertias (low, moderate, high). It found small, task-, inertia-, and time-specific responses, with low inertia showing a favorable CMJ response at 12 min (+1.88%, 95% CI 0.54 to 3.21) and high inertia showing a favorable SJ response at 12 min (+3.74%, 95% CI 1.34 to 6.15).
items.curatedReason: 飞轮半蹲训练确实能在篮球运动员中引起PAPE效应，但记住这效应是小幅、任务、惯性和时间特异性的。如果你想将其应用于赛前激活，不妨尝试低惯性负荷以改善CMJ，或高惯性负荷以改善SJ，并在12分钟左右进行测试，但效果可能因人而异。
items.titleZh: 飞轮训练对男性篮球运动员激活后表现增强的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项探索性交叉研究（N=20）调查了飞轮半深蹲训练在不同惯性负荷（低、中、高）下对大学男性篮球运动员激活后表现增强（PAPE）的急性影响。研究发现，表现提升效应是小幅度的、任务特异的、惯性特异的、时间特异的，其中低惯性负荷在12分钟时对 CMJ 表现有利（+1.88%，95% CI 0.54 to 3.21），高惯性负荷在12分钟时对 SJ 表现有利（+3.74%，95% CI 1.34 to 6.15）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Flywheel half-squat conditioning can induce PAPE in basketball players, but remember this effect is small, task-, inertia-, and time-specific. If you want to apply it for pre-game activation, consider low inertia for CMJ improvement or high inertia for SJ improvement, testing around 12 minutes, but outcomes may vary individually.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=20），仅限于大学生男性篮球运动员，且研究评估的急性效应持续时间较短，长期训练效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=20) and is limited to collegiate male basketball players. The assessed acute effects are short-lived, and long-term training efficacy remains unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (1536 participants) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) in people with stroke, with balance and cognitively integrated training being most effective, especially for those in the chronic stage with mild-moderate disability.
items.curatedReason: 跌倒预防是卒中康复的重中之重，这项高质量系统综述（18项RCT）明确指出，物理运动可将卒中患者的跌倒风险降低39%。特别是针对慢性期、中度残疾的患者，平衡与认知相结合的训练是你的首选干预，务必将其纳入治疗计划。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼可减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含18项随机对照试验（1536名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，体育锻炼显著减少了卒中患者跌倒次数达39%（IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]）。其中，平衡训练和认知整合的训练效果最佳，特别适用于卒中慢性期、轻中度残疾的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fall prevention is paramount in stroke rehabilitation. This high-quality systematic review (18 RCTs) unequivocally shows physical exercise reduces falls by 39% in stroke patients. For those in the chronic stage with mild-moderate disability, prioritize balance and cognitively integrated training; it must be a core part of your intervention.
items.limitation: 虽然运动减少了跌倒次数，但对受伤性跌倒和跌倒者的影响不那么显著，提示还需要进一步研究如何降低跌倒的严重程度。
items.limitationEn: While exercise reduced the number of falls, its effect on injurious falls and fallers was less apparent, suggesting further research is needed on mitigating fall severity.

items.title: Leader and Follower Roles in Adapted Tango Reveal Complementary Neural Routes to Motor Improvement in Parkinson's Disease
items.summary: An RCT randomized people with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's Disease (PD) to 12 weeks of adapted tango as Leaders, Followers, or a Control. Both dance groups showed significant clinical improvement, including reduced overall disease severity and motor impairment, with Leaders showing network stability and Followers increased sensorimotor/caudate-motor connectivity, suggesting complementary neural routes to motor improvement.
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者参与改编探戈舞蹈，无论是作为主导者（Leader）还是追随者（Follower），都能改善运动功能和疾病整体严重程度。这种双重机制提示，在设计康复干预时，可以同时考虑内部生成（Leader）和外部引导（Follower）的运动策略。
items.titleZh: 改编探戈中主导者和追随者的角色揭示帕金森病运动改善的互补神经通路
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验将轻中度帕金森病（PD）患者随机分配至12周的改编探戈主导者组、追随者组或对照组。结果显示，两个舞蹈组均表现出显著的临床改善，包括总体疾病严重程度和运动障碍的减轻。主导者组表现出网络稳定性，追随者组则显示感觉运动/尾状核-运动连接性增加，这提示运动改善存在互补的神经通路。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adapted tango, whether as a Leader or Follower, improves motor function and overall disease severity in Parkinson's disease. This dual mechanism suggests that both internally generated (Leader) and externally guided (Follower) movement strategies can be considered when designing rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步研究（pilot study），样本量较小，神经连接性分析基于静息态功能连接，不直接反映任务态下的脑活动。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, and neural connectivity analysis is based on resting-state functional connectivity, which does not directly reflect brain activity during task execution.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=163) found that home-based therapeutic patient education (TPE) delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team was associated with greater improvement in social participation post-stroke (mean FAI change: 6.02 vs 1.62, p < 0.001), especially when combined with physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性教育（特别是结合体育活动工作坊）与卒中后社会参与度的显著改善相关。在考虑卒中患者的社区康复方案时，请优先纳入教育和积极运动元素。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与法国生活活动指数（Frenchay Activities Index）改善的关联：一项回顾性队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=163）发现，由社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育（TPE）与卒中后社会参与度的显著改善相关（FAI平均变化：6.02 vs 1.62, p < 0.001），特别是当TPE结合了体育活动工作坊时。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based therapeutic education delivered by community stroke rehabilitation teams, especially when combined with physical activity workshops, is associated with significant improvements in social participation after stroke. Prioritize incorporating educational and active movement elements when planning community rehabilitation for stroke patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管调整了混杂因素，但其结论仍受观察性研究固有的局限性影响，不能确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective cohort study, its conclusions, despite adjustments for confounders, are subject to the inherent limitations of observational research and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Immediate and fatigue-related effects of subtalar sling taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.summary: An RCT (n=90) comparing rigid subtalar sling taping (RST), kinesio subtalar sling taping (KST), and sham taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability (CAI) found KST led to higher Y-Balance Test scores than sham taping post-fatigue and after recovery. RST and KST showed outcome-dependent effects, but no consistent superiority of one over the other was observed across all outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，肌内效贴和硬质贴扎在疲劳后都能在Y-平衡测试中改善表现，但效果因具体结局指标和时间点而异，没有一种方法能全面优于另一种。在临床实践中，可根据患者反应选择性使用。
items.titleZh: 副距骨吊带贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳患者的即时和疲劳相关影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=90）比较了硬质副距骨吊带贴扎（RST）、肌内效副距骨吊带贴扎（KST）和假贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者的影响。研究发现，KST 在疲劳后和恢复期，Y-平衡测试分数高于假贴扎。RST 和 KST 表现出依赖于结局的效应，但在所有结局中未观察到任一方法具有持续的优越性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability, both kinesiology tape and rigid taping can improve performance on the Y-Balance Test after fatigue, but effects vary by outcome and time point, with no consistent superiority of one over the other. Use these selectively based on patient response in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究观察到的一些差异虽然具有统计学意义，但其临床重要性需要进一步验证，且结果未在所有结局指标上保持一致。
items.limitationEn: Some observed differences, while statistically significant, require further validation for their clinical importance, and results were not consistent across all outcome measures.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Motor Module-Guided Human-Machine Interaction Promotes Improvement of Neuromuscular Coordination and Reduction in Motor Impairment in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with five chronic stroke survivors in the motor module-guided intervention and three in a force-guided control group found that the motor module-guided human-machine interaction intervention improved neuromuscular coordination and led to clinically meaningful, sustained reductions in upper extremity motor impairment, which correlated with enhanced stroke-induced motor module composition.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，肌模块引导的人机交互康复能有效改善慢性卒中患者的神经肌肉协调性，从而减轻运动障碍，且效果可保持。这为治疗卒中后上肢功能障碍提供了一个新的有前景的方向。
items.titleZh: 运动模块引导的人机交互促进慢性卒中患者神经肌肉协调性改善和运动障碍减轻：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对5名慢性卒中幸存者进行运动模块引导干预、3名幸存者进行力量引导对照的初步研究发现，运动模块引导的人机交互干预改善了神经肌肉协调性，并导致上肢运动障碍的临床有意义且持续的减轻，这与卒中引起的运动模块组成增强相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that motor module-guided human-machine interaction rehabilitation effectively improves neuromuscular coordination in chronic stroke survivors, reducing motor impairment with sustained effects. This offers a promising new direction for treating post-stroke upper extremity dysfunction.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步研究（pilot study），虽然结果有希望，但仍需更大规模的随机对照试验来验证其有效性和机制。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size. While the results are promising, larger randomized controlled trials are needed to validate its efficacy and mechanisms.

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A multi-centre RCT (n=504) found that adding a 7-minute pain science education film (PainSMART) to usual physiotherapy for musculoskeletal pain did not result in additional clinically meaningful benefits once physiotherapy commenced, though it may facilitate earlier improvements in self-efficacy and perceptions during waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 疼痛科学教育的短期数字策略（PainSMART）在患者等待初级理疗期间，能改善疼痛自我效能和疼痛认知，但不带来长期临床益处，不应替代常规物理治疗。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼疼痛患者等待初级理疗期间，附加短期数字疼痛教育策略（PainSMART）：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验（n=504）发现，对于肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，在常规理疗之外增加一个7分钟的疼痛科学教育视频（PainSMART）后，一旦理疗开始，并未带来额外的临床有意义的益处。但在等待期，它可能有助于患者提前改善疼痛自我效能和疼痛认知。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PainSMART digital pain science education strategy, while improving pain self-efficacy and perceptions in the short term while patients await physiotherapy, does not offer additional clinically meaningful long-term benefits once physiotherapy begins. Do not use it as a substitute for standard physiotherapy.
items.limitation: 本研究的疼痛自我效能在随访1（治疗前）有统计学差异，但在主要分析时间点（治疗后）差异不显著，提示其效果可能短暂且主要发生在等待期。
items.limitationEn: The statistically significant difference in pain self-efficacy was observed only at follow-up 1 (pre-physiotherapy consultation), but not at the primary analysis time points (post-consultation), suggesting its effect may be transient and primarily during the waiting period.

items.title: Autonomic responses to repeated locomotor perturbations in older adults: dissociation between phasic habituation and sustained tonic arousal.
items.summary: In 18 older adults, repeated slip perturbations during walking elicited a significant phasic increase in sympathetic nervous system (SNS) activity (%SCR) that habituated with repetition but restored with a change in perturbation direction. Tonic SNS activity (%SCL) remained elevated, suggesting sustained vigilance, supporting the potential benefit of perturbation-based balance training.
items.curatedReason: 老年人在行走时经历平衡扰动会触发交感神经系统反应，并迅速习惯于重复的、相同方向的扰动，但新方向的扰动会重新激发反应。这意味着基于扰动的平衡训练是有效的，但需多样化以维持警觉性。
items.titleZh: 老年人对重复步态扰动的自主神经反应：相位性适应与持续性张力性觉醒的分离。
items.summaryZh: 在18名老年人中，行走时重复的滑倒扰动会引起交感神经系统（SNS）活动的显著相位性增加（%SCR），这种反应随着重复而适应，但在扰动方向改变时又会恢复。张力性SNS活动（%SCL）持续升高，表明持续警觉，这支持了基于扰动的平衡训练的潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Older adults exhibit sympathetic nervous system responses to balance perturbations during walking, rapidly habituating to repeated, same-direction perturbations, but showing renewed responses to novel perturbation directions. This suggests that perturbation-based balance training is effective but requires diversification to maintain vigilance.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=18），且仅限于健康老年人，结果在外推至有平衡障碍或不同病理特征的老年人群时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=18) and was limited to healthy older adults, so results should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to older populations with balance impairments or different pathologies.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study found a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and education program for knee osteoarthritis was feasible and well-accepted in Brazilian primary health care, with high recruitment (87.3%) and retention (83%), and exploratory clinical outcomes suggesting improvements.
items.curatedReason: 这项巴西的研究表明，物理治疗师主导的、基于团体的骨关节炎运动与健康教育项目在基层医疗中可行且广受欢迎。这支持将同类循证方案整合到常规护理中，尤其是在资源受限的环境。
items.titleZh: 巴西基层医疗中针对膝骨关节炎患者的团体健康教育和运动实施：一项混合方法研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法实施研究显示，在巴西基层医疗中，由物理治疗师主导的膝骨关节炎团体运动和健康教育项目是可行且广受欢迎的，招募率（87.3%）和依从性（83%）均高，探索性临床结局提示患者症状有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian study demonstrates the feasibility and high acceptance of a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and health education program for knee osteoarthritis in primary care. This supports integrating similar evidence-based programs into routine care, especially in resource-constrained settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项混合方法实施研究，探索性临床结局提示了改善，但并非以临床疗效为主要目标。
items.limitationEn: This was a mixed-methods implementation study, and while exploratory clinical outcomes suggested improvements, it was not primarily designed to evaluate clinical efficacy.

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
